speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Given your 3-week history of fever, fatigue, easy bruising, and severe leg pain, I am very concerned about bone marrow infiltration. Have you noticed any swollen joints or visible lumps under the skin?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: Yes, please tell me: does the severe leg pain worsen when you touch the bones or press on the long bones of your legs? Also, have you noticed any swelling in your belly or back, or any tiny red spots on your skin?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and easy bruising. I also have Fever, Severe leg pain that disturbs sleep.
